lines: Na tha kuchh to Khuda tha, kuchh na hota to Khuda hota.
couplets.en: When there was nothing, God was there, and if nothing ever came to be, God would still be there.

lines: Na tha kuchh to Khuda tha, kuchh na hota to Khuda hota.

lines: Duboya mujh ko hone ne, na hota main to kya hota?
couplets.en: My very being drowned me, and had I never been, what would have happened?

lines: Na tha kuchh to Khuda tha, kuchh na hota to Khuda hota.

lines: Hua jab gham se yun behis, to gham kya sar ke katne ka?
couplets.en: When grief had numbed me so, why grieve over losing my head?

lines: Hua jab gham se yun behis, to gham kya sar ke katne ka?

lines: Na hota gar juda tan se, to zanu par dhara hota.
couplets.en: Had it stayed upon my body, it would have rested on my knees.

lines: Hui muddat ki Ghalib mar gaya, par yaad aata hai.
couplets.en: Ghalib has long been dead, yet he still comes to mind.

lines: Woh har ek baat pe kehna ki yun hota to kya hota?
couplets.en: Whatever the matter, he would always ask, what if it had been this way?
